connections.nameHint: The name on the tab. Left empty, it comes from the site address.
connections.secretKept: Saved: {{hint}}. Enter a new one to replace it; leave empty to keep it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.boardsHint: Connected tools. Click one to edit it.
settings.refreshHint: Tasks refresh every hour and when the app opens.
settings.notificationsHint: Alerts for new tasks; turn on/off in macOS settings.

playground.title: Design system
playground.worstCaseHint: Stress everything with long names, missing fields and other scripts.
playground.domainHint: The domain in the address bar while Jira is open.
playground.guideHint: Generated from the provider definition, with copyable steps.

errors.unauthorized: Sign-in was refused. I stopped retrying so your account isn't locked; edit the connection and update the details.
errors.notFound: Site not found. Check the {{app}} address.
errors.network: Couldn't connect. Check your internet connection.
errors.rateLimited: {{app}}'s request limit was reached. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalidInput: Details are missing or wrong. Edit the connection.
errors.keychain: macOS Keychain wasn't reachable. Allow the prompt and try again.
errors.store: App data wasn't reachable. Try restarting the app.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this in {{app}}.
errors.captcha: {{app}} locked sign-in behind a CAPTCHA. Sign in to {{app}} once in your browser to pass it, then press Retry.
errors.blocked: Your company's network security blocked this request. You can do it in {{app}}; for a lasting fix, ask your security team to allow {{app}} API access.

filters.title: Filters
filters.noMatchHint: Remove a filter or clear them all.

comments.title: Comments
comments.deleteDescription: It's removed from {{app}} for good and can't be undone.

detail.epicEmpty: No issues in this epic yet.

welcome.title: Welcome to AssignedToMe
welcome.body: Every task assigned to you, from all your boards, in one place.

boards.title: Connect your boards
boards.body: Every tool you connect becomes a board, and your tasks refresh on their own; pick how often in Settings.

providers.title: Works with your tools
providers.body: See your tasks from Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps in one list.

surfaces.title: In the menubar, or as a window
surfaces.body: It's always one click away in the menubar. You can also use it as a full window; close the window and it keeps running in the menubar.

notify.title: Stay in the loop
notify.body: Get notified when a task is assigned to you. Pick how often to check in Settings.

privacy.title: Your keys stay with you
privacy.body: API keys stay in this Mac's Keychain and go only to the tool they belong to. If you move them to your phone, they're encrypted with a one-time code.

update.failed: Couldn't install the update. Try again later.
update.checkFailed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your connection.

transfer.signInNote_one: {{count}} board was added with a sign-in. It goes without it, and the phone asks you to sign in once.
transfer.signInNote_other: {{count}} boards were added with a sign-in. They go without it, and the phone asks you to sign in once.
transfer.sendHint: Move your boards, keys included, to the AssignedToMe app on your phone.
transfer.sendStep: On your phone, open Settings → Receive from desktop. Enter the code it shows here.
transfer.scan: Scan this with your phone. It works for 10 minutes and only with that code.
transfer.tooMany: Too many boards for one QR. Pick fewer and send the rest in a second round.
transfer.receiveStep: On your phone, open Settings → Send to desktop and enter this code. Then paste what it copies below.
transfer.wrongCode: This text was made for a different code. Start again on the phone with the code shown here.
transfer.expired: This transfer is older than 10 minutes. Make a new one.
transfer.noBoards: Nothing to add: these boards use tools this version doesn't know.
transfer.closeWhenDone: When your phone says the boards were added, you can close this.
